prompt: The client's sales are falling, and it wants to know why. Which takeaway matters most?

options.feedback: True, but it doesn't answer the client's question.

options.text: The competitor cut its price while the client held its price
options.feedback: Right. The competitor fell from $10 to $8 (−20%); the client stayed at $10.

options.text: The client cut its price in March
options.feedback: That misreads the chart: The client's price stayed at $10 all year.

options.text: Customers are switching because of the competitor's new ads
options.feedback: The chart doesn't show this. It may be true, but there is no data here to support it.

explanation: The competitor cut its price while the client held its price. The competitor fell from $10 to $8 (−20%); the client stayed at $10.

extras.proof: The competitor fell from $10 to $8 (−20%); the client stayed at $10.
